name: domain-experts
description: Toolkit for building, evaluating, evolving, contributing, and CHATTING WITH domain expert agents in Claude Code. Five skills: domain-creator (build / uplevel), domain-eval (test), domain-capture (add knowledge), domain-contribute (push back), and domain-chat (open a browser chat UI for an agent via agent-kit). /domain-chat spawns a local agent-kit dev server (clones it into the project if absent, gitignored) and opens the browser at the right agent — auto-discovers persona, KB, and memory with zero config.
